The edit preserves terminal-cell geometry, SGR state, palette, neighboring artwork, the title and sysop details, creator and shading credits, greetings, and every retained non-selected cell. Titles, attribution, identity, dialogue, structural lettering, art-integrated words, and ambiguity remain intact.

normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 visible terminal-cell rows after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Every accepted row pins exact raw projected and rendered hashes plus one-based inclusive blank-column ranges.
policy: Fail-closed review of first-person creator-production cues in every static color-script payload.
